_baseline: Current compatibility surface expected by the Python controller. /health mirrors the node's native health document consumed by the controller's node probes; /api/v1/connection mirrors the controller-facing compatibility status endpoint. Type names are checked by ozma-node/tests/parity.rs. The connection document also reports input sink availability/injection, read-only codec state, and 'audio: not-implemented'. HLS is opt-in and honest: 'not-configured' without --hls, 'running' only once stream.m3u8 exists, 'failed' plus hls_error otherwise. WebRTC is still not-implemented and is never faked.
